messages:
maren: Quick heads up — we're doing a surprise at 4pm today in the 3rd-floor kitchen for Alex. Two things: promotion to Senior PM :tada: and a tiny baby-shower. Can folks make it?

kai: OMG congrats Alex!! I'll bring balloons. :balloon:

zoe: I can do gluten-free cupcakes (labelled). What flavors people want?

people-ops: Added event to the calendar for 4:00pm, 3rd-floor kitchen. Invite sent to the company 'random' channel.

calendar-bot: Calendar invite created: https://calendar.example/ev/1973456789 (internal link)

jordan: Confetti? maybe skip — remember the sprinkler sensor freakout last year :grimacing:

rachael: YES skip the messy confetti. also last time the janitor wrote a strongly worded haiku.

matt: I can bring those handheld streamer poppers that aren't messy (battery ones).

leo: Would love to do a quick 3–4 minute shoutout segment — 1 min from me, 1 min from product, then cake. Alex deserves the audible kudos.

alex: wait what??! you are all terrible at surprises and amazing at surprises. I'll be there. :( :joy: Thank you everyone.

maren: Also, people-ops collected a little gift card pool — if you'd like to contribute DM @people-ops. They offered to handle checkout & receipt.

zoe: Flavor poll: chocolate fudge, lemon tart, salted caramel — vote now.

kai: chocolate fudge 

jordan: salted caramel

rachael: lemon tart (but also would eat all of them)

z: (typo)

matt: Minor logistics Q — Alex, are you ok with Luna (your dog) coming by after the vet? She was in your DM earlier?

alex: yes omg Luna might pop in for like 20 min post-appointment. she's super chill. hope that's fine. :dog:

people-ops: Quick reminder about animals in office: notify people-ops 1 hour beforehand if bringing a pet for allergy accommodations. Thanks!

maren: Good catch. Alex — can you DM people-ops to confirm Luna's ETA?

alex: done. DM sent.

zoe: I'm happy to be the "distractor" at 3:55 — I can lead Alex on a fake snack run.

maren: Perfect. Zoe, you are now Official Distractor. :sunglasses:

jordan: I'll bring non-messy poppers and a tiny banner that says "congrats & baby"

rachael: GIF: https://giphy.example/congrats-dance

leo: I'll organize the 2-min kudos queue, quick bullets only pls so we don't delay cake.

alex: you people are wild. thank you. seriously touched. see you at 4!

maren: Final note — please avoid latex balloons if anyone is allergic. Labels on cupcakes please. See you all soon :confetti_ball:
